name: whats-in-qa
description: /whats-in-qa lists the Jira tickets already deployed to an Octopus environment (QA) and ready to test, matched by ticket key in the deployed commits

sprint.title: Sprint
sprint.description: Sprint name ("Sprint 45"), sprint id, or open for every open sprint of the projects. Empty: no sprint filter.

projects.title: Jira projects
projects.description: Comma-separated Jira project keys, e.g. PROJ,CORE.

components.title: Components
components.description: Comma-separated components to include. Empty: any component.

statuses.title: Only statuses
statuses.description: Comma-separated statuses to include. Empty: any status.

assignee.title: Assignee
assignee.description: me, or comma-separated account ids. Empty: anyone.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Comma-separated labels to include. Empty: any label.

extraJql.title: Extra JQL
extraJql.description: Any extra JQL clause, ANDed with the filters above.

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Your Jira Cloud host (e.g. acme.atlassian.net), read through the claude.ai Atlassian connector

octopusSpace.title: Octopus space
octopusSpace.description: Octopus space name, read through the Octopus Deploy MCP server

octopusEnvironment.title: Octopus environment
octopusEnvironment.description: Environment whose latest successful deployments are checked.

octopusProjects.title: Octopus projects
octopusProjects.description: Comma-separated Octopus project names whose releases carry GitHub build information.

lookbackDays.title: Commit window (days)
lookbackDays.description: How many days of the deployed build's history are searched for ticket keys.
